blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, HOME retained verified Pool16 implementation 0x366049d336e73cfaf39c6a933780ca4c96ea084c and ProxyAdmin 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f. Its owner and the Pool16 servicer are Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486, currently 3-of-5, with empty module pagination; guard and fallback were not inspected. Pool16 exposes standard transfers and self-burn, with no blacklist, pause, freeze or privileged holder-burn method in the fetched ABI. The proxy upgrade path can replace that implementation. Current holder terms excluding legal restrictions were not found in the issuer website, official README/FAQ or mortgage-originator agreements. The reviewed possible access verdict remains warranted; absence of a blacklist method is not a guarantee against future upgrade or legal restrictions. Earlier characterization of the controller as a legacy pre-Safe MultiSigWallet is corrected by current pinned singleton and VERSION reads.
